title: Integration test: RFC 4644 streaming peering between two transit nodes
description: End-to-end test confirming that two transit daemon instances can peer using RFC 4644 streaming mode. One node feeds articles via CHECK+TAKETHIS; the other stores them and propagates over gossipsub. Validates that IHAVE fallback also works when streaming is not negotiated. Artifact: integration test in usenet-ipfs-transit test suite.
